verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: De novo, veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֡ם אֱמֹר֩ לִנְגִ֨יד צֹ֜ר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה יַ֣עַן גָּבַ֤הּ לִבְּךָ֙ וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ל אָ֔נִי מוֹשַׁ֧ב אֱלֹהִ֛ים יָשַׁ֖בְתִּי בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּ֑ים וְאַתָּ֤ה אָדָם֙ וְֽלֹא־ אֵ֔ל וַתִּתֵּ֥ן לִבְּךָ֖ כְּלֵ֥ב אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām ’ĕ·mōr lin·ḡîḏ ṣōr kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an gā·ḇah lib·bə·ḵā wat·tō·mer ’êl ’ā·nî mō·wō·šaḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm yā·šaḇ·tî bə·lêḇ yam·mîm wə·’at·tāh ’ā·ḏām wə·lō- ’êl wat·tit·tên lib·bə·ḵā kə·lêḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Son of man tell the ruler of Tyre that this is what the Lord GOD . . . says Your heart is proud and you have said I am a god I sit in the seat of gods in the heart of the sea Yet you are a man and not a god though you have regarded your heart as that of a god
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, dize ao príncipe de Tiro: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porquanto o teu coração se elevou, e disseste: Eu sou um deus, na cadeira de Deus me assento, no meio dos mares; todavia, tu és homem e não Deus, embora pusesses o teu coração como o coração de Deus,

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה חָכָ֛ם אַתָּ֖ה מִדָּנִאֵל כָּל־ סָת֖וּם לֹ֥א עֲמָמֽוּךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḥā·ḵām ’at·tāh mid·då̄·ni·ʾēl kāl- sā·ṯūm lō ‘ă·mā·mū·ḵā
verses.literal: Behold you are wiser than Daniel . . . no secret is hidden from you
verses.literalPt: eis que tu és mais sábio que Daniel; não há segredo que se possa esconder de ti:

verses.original: בְּחָכְמָֽתְךָ֙ וּבִתְבוּנָ֣תְךָ֔ עָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ חָ֑יִל וַתַּ֛עַשׂ זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף בְּאוֹצְרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nā·ṯə·ḵā ‘ā·śî·ṯā lə·ḵā ḥā·yil wat·ta·‘aś zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ bə·’ō·wṣ·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained your wealth and amassed gold and silver for your treasuries
verses.literalPt: pela tua sabedoria e pelo teu entendimento, adquiriste para ti riquezas e puseste ouro e prata nos teus tesouros;

verses.original: בְּרֹ֧ב חָכְמָתְךָ֛ בִּרְכֻלָּתְךָ֖ הִרְבִּ֣יתָ חֵילֶ֑ךָ וַיִּגְבַּ֥הּ לְבָבְךָ֖ בְּחֵילֶֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·rōḇ ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯə·ḵā bir·ḵul·lā·ṯə·ḵā hir·bî·ṯā ḥê·le·ḵā way·yiḡ·bah lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā bə·ḥê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth but your heart has grown proud because of it
verses.literalPt: pela tua grande sabedoria e pelo teu tráfico, aumentaste as tuas riquezas, e o teu coração acha-se exaltado por causa das tuas riquezas.

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֛עַן תִּתְּךָ֥ אֶת־ לְבָבְךָ֖ כְּלֵ֥ב אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an tit·tə·ḵā ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā kə·lêḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Because you regard your heart as the heart of a god
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porquanto puseste o teu coração como o coração de Deus,

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ זָרִ֔ים עָרִיצֵ֖י גּוֹיִ֑ם וְהֵרִ֤יקוּ חַרְבוֹתָם֙ עַל־ יְפִ֣י חָכְמָתֶ֔ךָ וְחִלְּל֖וּ יִפְעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî mê·ḇî ‘ā·le·ḵā zā·rîm ‘ā·rî·ṣê gō·w·yim wə·hê·rî·qū ḥar·ḇō·w·ṯām ‘al- yə·p̄î ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḥil·lə·lū yip̄·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: behold I will bring foreigners against you the most ruthless of nations They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and will defile your splendor
verses.literalPt: eis que trarei sobre ti estrangeiros, os terríveis dentre as nações; eles desembainharão as suas espadas contra a formosura da tua sabedoria e mancharão o teu resplendor.

verses.original: לַשַּׁ֖חַת יֽוֹרִד֑וּךָ וָמַ֛תָּה מְמוֹתֵ֥י חָלָ֖ל בְּלֵ֥ב יַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: laš·ša·ḥaṯ yō·w·ri·ḏū·ḵā wā·mat·tāh mə·mō·w·ṯê ḥā·lāl bə·lêḇ yam·mîm
verses.literal: They will bring you down to the Pit and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas
verses.literalPt: Far-te-ão descer à cova, e morrerás da morte dos que são mortos no coração dos mares.

verses.original: הֶאָמֹ֤ר תֹּאמַר֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אָ֔נִי לִפְנֵ֖י הֹֽרְגֶ֑ךָ וְאַתָּ֥ה אָדָ֛ם וְלֹא־ אֵ֖ל בְּיַ֥ד מְחַלְלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: he·’ā·mōr tō·mar ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ā·nî lip̄·nê hō·rə·ḡe·ḵā wə·’at·tāh ’ā·ḏām wə·lō- ’êl bə·yaḏ mə·ḥal·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Will you still say . . . I am a god in the presence of those who slay you You will be only a man not a god in the hands of those who wound you
verses.literalPt: Diante daquele que te matar, porventura, ainda dirás: Eu sou Deus? Porém tu és homem e não Deus, na mão do que te mata.

verses.original: מוֹתֵ֧י עֲרֵלִ֛ים תָּמ֖וּת בְּיַד־ זָרִ֑ים כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mō·w·ṯê ‘ă·rê·lîm tā·mūṯ bə·yaḏ- zā·rîm kî ’ă·nî ḏib·bar·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners For I have spoken declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Pela mão dos estrangeiros, morrerás da morte dos incircuncisos, porque eu o falei, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Demais, veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שָׂ֥א קִינָ֖ה עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ צ֑וֹר וְאָמַ֣רְתָּ לּ֗וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אַתָּה֙ חוֹתֵ֣ם תָּכְנִ֔ית מָלֵ֥א חָכְמָ֖ה וּכְלִ֥יל יֹֽפִי׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām śā qî·nāh ‘al- me·leḵ ṣō·wr wə·’ā·mar·tā lōw kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’at·tāh ḥō·w·ṯêm tā·ḵə·nîṯ mā·lê ḥāḵ·māh ū·ḵə·lîl yō·p̄î
verses.literal: Son of man take up a lament for the king of Tyre and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says You were the seal of perfection full of wisdom and perfect in beauty
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, faze uma lamentação sobre o rei de Tiro e dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Tu eras o selo da simetria e a perfeição da sabedoria e da formosura.

verses.original: בְּעֵ֨דֶן גַּן־ אֱלֹהִ֜ים הָיִ֗יתָ כָּל־ אֶ֨בֶן יְקָרָ֤ה מְסֻכָתֶ֙ךָ֙ אֹ֣דֶם פִּטְדָ֞ה וְיָהֲלֹ֗ם תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֙הַם֙ וְיָ֣שְׁפֵ֔ה סַפִּ֣יר נֹ֔פֶךְ וּבָרְקַ֖ת וְזָהָ֑ב מְלֶ֨אכֶת תֻּפֶּ֤יךָ וּנְקָבֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּ֔ךְ בְּי֥וֹם הִבָּרַאֲךָ֖ כּוֹנָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘ê·ḏen gan- ’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·yî·ṯā kāl- ’e·ḇen yə·qā·rāh mə·su·ḵā·ṯe·ḵā ’ō·ḏem piṭ·ḏāh wə·yā·hă·lōm tar·šîš šō·ham wə·yā·šə·p̄êh sap·pîr nō·p̄eḵ ū·ḇā·rə·qaṯ wə·zā·hāḇ mə·le·ḵeṯ tup·pe·ḵā ū·nə·qā·ḇe·ḵā bāḵ bə·yō·wm hib·bā·ra·’ă·ḵā kō·w·nā·nū
verses.literal: You were in Eden the garden of God Every kind of precious stone adorned you ruby topaz and diamond beryl onyx and jasper sapphire turquoise and emerald Your mountings and settings were crafted in gold prepared on the day of your creation
verses.literalPt: Estiveste no Éden, jardim de Deus; cobrias-te de todas as pedras preciosas: o sárdio, o topázio, o diamante, o berilo, o ônix, o jaspe, a safira, a esmeralda, o carbúnculo e o ouro. Em ti se faziam os teus tambores e os teus pífaros; no dia em que foste criado foram preparados.

verses.original: אַ֨תְּ־ כְּר֔וּב מִמְשַׁ֖ח הַסּוֹכֵ֑ךְ וּנְתַתִּ֗יךָ בְּהַ֨ר קֹ֤דֶשׁ אֱלֹהִים֙ הָיִ֔יתָ בְּת֥וֹךְ אַבְנֵי־ אֵ֖שׁ הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at- kə·rūḇ mim·šaḥ has·sō·w·ḵêḵ ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā bə·har qō·ḏeš ’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·yî·ṯā bə·ṯō·wḵ ’aḇ·nê- ’êš hiṯ·hal·lā·ḵə·tā
verses.literal: You were anointed as a guardian cherub for I had ordained you You were on the holy mountain of God you walked among the fiery stones
verses.literalPt: Tu eras o querubim ungido que cobre, e estabeleci-te, de sorte que estivesses sobre o monte santo de Deus; andaste no meio das pedras de fogo.

verses.original: תָּמִ֤ים אַתָּה֙ בִּדְרָכֶ֔יךָ מִיּ֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָ֑ךְ עַד־ נִמְצָ֥א עַוְלָ֖תָה בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: tā·mîm ’at·tāh biḏ·rā·ḵe·ḵā mî·yō·wm hib·bā·rə·’āḵ ‘aḏ- nim·ṣā ‘aw·lā·ṯāh bāḵ
verses.literal: From the day you were created you were blameless in your ways until wickedness was found in you
verses.literalPt: Tu eras perfeito nos teus caminhos desde o dia em que foste criado até que a iniquidade se achou em ti.

verses.original: בְּרֹ֣ב רְכֻלָּתְךָ֗ מָל֧וּ תוֹכְךָ֛ חָמָ֖ס וַֽתֶּחֱטָ֑א וָאֶחַלֶּלְךָ֩ מֵהַ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֤ים וָֽאַבֶּדְךָ֙ כְּר֣וּב הַסֹּכֵ֔ךְ מִתּ֖וֹךְ אַבְנֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rōḇ rə·ḵul·lā·ṯə·ḵā mā·lū ṯō·wḵ·ḵā ḥā·mās wat·te·ḥĕ·ṭā wā·’e·ḥal·lel·ḵā mê·har ’ĕ·lō·hîm wā·’ab·beḏ·ḵā kə·rūḇ has·sō·ḵêḵ mit·tō·wḵ ’aḇ·nê- ’êš
verses.literal: By the vastness of your trade you were filled with violence and you sinned So I drove you in disgrace from the mountain of God and I banished you O guardian cherub from among the fiery stones
verses.literalPt: Pela abundância do teu tráfico, encheram de violência o teu interior, e pecaste; portanto te lancei, profanado, do monte de Deus, e te exterminei, ó querubim cobridor, do meio das pedras de fogo.

verses.original: גָּבַ֤הּ לִבְּךָ֙ בְּיָפְיֶ֔ךָ שִׁחַ֥תָּ חָכְמָתְךָ֖ עַל־ יִפְעָתֶ֑ךָ עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הִשְׁלַכְתִּ֗יךָ לִפְנֵ֧י מְלָכִ֛ים נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְרַ֥אֲוָה בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: gā·ḇah lib·bə·ḵā bə·yā·p̄ə·ye·ḵā ši·ḥa·tā ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯə·ḵā ‘al- yip̄·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā ‘al- ’e·reṣ hiš·laḵ·tî·ḵā lip̄·nê mə·lā·ḵîm nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lə·ra·’ă·wāh ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Your heart grew proud of your beauty you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor so I cast you to the earth I made you a spectacle before kings
verses.literalPt: Elevou-se o teu coração por causa da tua formosura, corrompeste a tua sabedoria por causa do teu resplendor; lancei-te por terra, diante dos reis te pus, para que te contemplem.

verses.original: מֵרֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֶ֗יךָ בְּעֶ֙וֶל֙ רְכֻלָּ֣תְךָ֔ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑יךָ וָֽאוֹצִא־ אֵ֤שׁ מִתּֽוֹכְךָ֙ הִ֣יא אֲכָלַ֔תְךָ וָאֶתֶּנְךָ֤ לְאֵ֙פֶר֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ רֹאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·rōḇ ‘ă·wō·ne·ḵā bə·‘e·wel rə·ḵul·lā·ṯə·ḵā ḥil·lal·tā miq·dā·še·ḵā wā·’ō·w·ṣi- ’êš mit·tō·wḵ·ḵā hî ’ă·ḵā·laṯ·ḵā wā·’et·ten·ḵā lə·’ê·p̄er ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ lə·‘ê·nê kāl- rō·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: By the multitude of your iniquities and the dishonesty of your trading you have profaned your sanctuaries So I made fire come from within you and it consumed you I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the eyes of all who saw you
verses.literalPt: Pela multidão das tuas iniquidades, na injustiça do teu tráfico, tens profanado os meus santuários; portanto, fiz sair do meio de ti fogo, que te devorou, e te reduzi a cinzas sobre a terra, à vista de todos os que te contemplam.

verses.original: כָּל־ יוֹדְעֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּֽעַמִּ֔ים שָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלֶ֑יךָ בַּלָּה֣וֹת הָיִ֔יתָ וְאֵינְךָ֖ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- yō·wḏ·‘e·ḵā bā·‘am·mîm šā·mə·mū ‘ā·le·ḵā bal·lā·hō·wṯ hā·yî·ṯā wə·’ê·nə·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: All the nations who know you are appalled over you You have come to a horrible end and will be no more . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Todos os que te conhecerem entre os povos ficarão espantados de ti; tu te tornas em pavor e tu não subsistirás mais.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶל־ צִיד֑וֹן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām śîm pā·ne·ḵā ’el- ṣî·ḏō·wn wə·hin·nā·ḇê ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: Son of man set your face against Sidon and prophesy against her
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, vira o teu rosto para Sidom, e profetiza contra ela,

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ צִיד֔וֹן וְנִכְבַּדְתִּ֖י בְּתוֹכֵ֑ךְ וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בַּעֲשׂ֥וֹתִי בָ֛הּ שְׁפָטִ֖ים וְנִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî ‘ā·la·yiḵ ṣî·ḏō·wn wə·niḵ·baḏ·tî bə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ba·‘ă·śō·w·ṯî ḇāh šə·p̄ā·ṭîm wə·niq·daš·tî ḇāh
verses.literal: And you are to declare that this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I am against you O Sidon and I will be glorified within you They will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments against her and demonstrate My holiness through her
verses.literalPt: e dize: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Eis que sou contra ti, Sidom, e serei glorificado no meio de ti. Saberão que eu sou Jeová, quando nela eu tiver executado juízos e nela for santificado.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ בָ֞הּ דֶּ֤בֶר וָדָם֙ בְּח֣וּצוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְנִפְלַ֤ל חָלָל֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ בְּחֶ֥רֶב עָלֶ֖יהָ מִסָּבִ֑יב וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ·tî- ḇāh de·ḇer wā·ḏām bə·ḥū·ṣō·w·ṯe·hā wə·nip̄·lal ḥā·lāl bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh bə·ḥe·reḇ ‘ā·le·hā mis·sā·ḇîḇ wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will send a plague against her and shed blood in her streets the slain will fall within her while the sword is against her on every side Then they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Pois lhe enviarei peste e sangue nas suas ruas; os feridos cairão no meio dela, estando a espada sobre ela por todos os lados; e saberão que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל סִלּ֤וֹן מַמְאִיר֙ וְק֣וֹץ מַכְאִ֔ב מִכֹּל֙ סְבִ֣יבֹתָ֔ם הַשָּׁאטִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yih·yeh ‘ō·wḏ lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl sil·lō·wn mam·’îr wə·qō·wṣ maḵ·’iḇ mik·kōl sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯām haš·šā·ṭîm ’ō·w·ṯām wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·nî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: For the people of Israel will no longer face a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all around them who treat them with contempt Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Para a casa de Israel não haverá espinho que pique, nem abrolho que cause dor, entre os que se acham ao redor deles e os tratam com despeito; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ בְּקַבְּצִ֣י׀ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִן־ הָֽעַמִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפֹ֣צוּ בָ֔ם וְנִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָ֖ם לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְיָֽשְׁבוּ֙ עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְעַבְדִּ֥י לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·qab·bə·ṣî ’eṯ- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl min- hā·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer nā·p̄ō·ṣū ḇām wə·niq·daš·tî ḇām lə·‘ê·nê hag·gō·w·yim wə·yā·šə·ḇū ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lə·‘aḇ·dî lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered I will show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations Then they will dwell in their own land which I have given to My servant Jacob
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Quando eu tiver ajuntado a casa de Israel, tirando-os dentre os povos entre os quais se acham espalhados e for santificado neles à vista das nações, habitarão na sua terra que eu dei ao meu servo Jacó.

verses.original: וְיָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶיהָ֮ לָבֶטַח֒ וּבָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְיָשְׁב֖וּ לָבֶ֑טַח בַּעֲשׂוֹתִ֣י שְׁפָטִ֗ים בְּכֹ֨ל הַשָּׁאטִ֤ים אֹתָם֙ מִסְּבִ֣יבוֹתָ֔ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šə·ḇū ‘ā·le·hā lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ ū·ḇā·nū ḇāt·tîm wə·nā·ṭə·‘ū ḵə·rā·mîm wə·yā·šə·ḇū lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ ba·‘ă·śō·w·ṯî šə·p̄ā·ṭîm bə·ḵōl haš·šā·ṭîm ’ō·ṯām mis·sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: And there they will dwell . . . securely build houses and plant vineyards They will dwell securely when I execute judgments against all those around them who treat them with contempt Then they will know that I am the LORD their God
verses.literalPt: Nela, habitarão seguros, plantarão vinhas e habitarão seguros, quando eu tiver executado juízos sobre todos os que os tratarem com despeito ao redor deles; e saberão que eu sou Jeová, seu Deus.
